## Diagnosis: the bundle regression is not lucide — it is this PR's lockfile

Measured locally on the current head `08e8a477` against its own parent `9de7758d`, so the two trees differ by nothing except this PR. My local build reproduces CI byte-for-byte: same entry chunk `index-DnpWCgVQ.js`, same **4849.4 KB** eager closure.

### Eager-closure chunk diff

Only **two** of the 50 eager chunks change at all.

| chunk | base `9de7758d` | head `08e8a477` | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `vendor-objectstack` | 1206.2 KB | 2579.5 KB | **+1373.3 KB** |
| `ui-components` | 383.8 KB | 387.7 KB | +3.9 KB |
| *(the other 48 eager chunks)* | — | — | 0 KB |
| **aggregate** | **3472.2 KB** | **4849.4 KB** | **+1377.3 KB** |

Budget is 3512.7 KB. So **99.7% of the regression is one chunk**, and lucide's real cost is the +3.9 KB in `ui-components`.

### Traced cause

lucide-react 1.31.0 and 1.40.0 are packaged **identically**. With `version` stripped and keys sorted, the two `package.json` files are byte-identical: no `exports` field in either, same `main` (`dist/cjs/lucide-react.js`), same `module` (`dist/esm/lucide-react.mjs`), same `sideEffects: false`, same `files`. `dist/esm/DynamicIcon.mjs` differs only in its license banner; `dynamic.mjs` differs only in the banner; `dynamic.js` differs only by an eslint directive moving one line. Nothing in the bump can defeat tree-shaking, and the repo's own import spellings are already the code-split ones (`lucide-react/dynamic.mjs` via `getIcon` / `getLazyIcon`). Content growth 1.31 to 1.40 is 32 icons, about 1.9 KB in `dynamicIconImports.mjs`.

The regression is **collateral lockfile re-resolution**. Comparing package identities in `pnpm-lock.yaml`:

- base to this head: **46** package identities changed, and the non-lucide ones downgrade the whole `@objectstack/*` family from **17.3.0 to 17.2.0** and fork `zod` into `4.4.3` + `4.5.4`, which forks `ai` and `@ai-sdk/*` with it.
- base to a lockfile regenerated from base with only the lucide bump: **12** changed identities, **all of them lucide**.

The fork splits the workspace across two physical copies of `@objectstack/spec`:

| consumer | base | this head |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/console` | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) | spec 17.3.0 (**zod 4.5.4**) |
| `packages/core` | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) | spec 17.3.0 (**zod 4.5.4**) |
| `packages/runner` | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) | spec 17.3.0 (**zod 4.5.4**) |
| `packages/app-shell` | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) |
| `packages/components` | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) | spec 17.3.0 (zod 4.4.3) |

Two different real paths, so nothing can dedupe them and both land in the bundle. Confirmed in the built artifact: `vendor-objectstack` goes 4,030,557 to 8,423,436 raw bytes (2.09x), the `objectstack/spec` marker count goes 620 to 1136, and `authorable-surface` goes 7 to 21.

Every `@objectstack/spec` range in this workspace is a floating `^17.0.0` / `^17.1.0` / `^17.2.0`, and the registry `latest` is 17.3.0 — so a *fresh* resolve can never pick 17.2.0. This lockfile was resolved against a stale view and carried forward across rebases (note the branch is still named `...lucide-react-1.35.0` while the title says 1.40.0).
